# Astronomical 0.2.76
## Changes
- The menu bar icon now opens the telemetry panel on the first click and keeps it open, no matter which application was in front before the click. - Quitting the Astronomical menu application now also stops the local server and its inference worker, including when the server was started before the menu application was launched, so no Astronomical background processes for that instance outlive Quit.
## Compatibility
- macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later on Apple silicon. - Existing configuration, model locations, and prompt-cache state are preserved; no migration is required.
## Distribution
This release is signed with a Developer ID Application certificate, notarized with Apple, and delivered as a stapled disk image. The published disk image matches the release manifest's SHA-256 digest, and updates arrive through the signed Sparkle appcast feed.
